scope: Actual battle forfeiture followed by Bacta placement and next deploy-phase patient return. Seven cases: no/one/two FX-7 droids, decline, excluded droid, attached weapon, and asterisk-deploy Jawa. Compare offer, inactive state, stacked/Lost/hand destinations, damage credit, recovery cost and weapon loss.
AR pp17,27,104,113,138 establish just-lost removal, inactive patient uniqueness, current Bacta/FX errata and the asterisk deploy-cost exception.
limitations: Fixtures arrange boards and cards. They do not certify complete decks or full matches. The native deployment/cancellation/host departure/save validation and browser checks are additional regressions, not fresh reference comparisons.

General global deploy-cost modifiers, full inactive/captured/aboard states, supporting/face-down stacks, Redemption, loss prevention and additional provider cards remain unfinished. Full native admission remains closed.

Browser verification uses real engine projections/commands with isolated API routes, not production full-match admission. External card artwork did not load in local screenshots; patient labels, responsive layout, inspection, recovery and refresh were verified.

officialExceptions.authority: Official Advanced Rulebook p138, Bacta Tank: printed asterisk deploy cost treated as zero.
officialExceptions.explanation: Pinned Card1_012 defines deploy cost as 1 to implement its two-player deployment requirement. Bacta Tank uses that general query without applying the explicit asterisk exception.
